headline: A 2006 executive order created a federal Task Force on New Americans.
what_it_does: This order set up a federal task force focused on "New Americans," a term usually used for immigrants and new citizens. Based on the title alone, it appears to organize federal efforts related to helping immigrants settle in and take part in American life. No summary was provided, so the task force's exact duties, members, and powers are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are the apparent focus of the task force's work, though the specific effects are not stated in the available material.
Some agencies would likely take part in or support the task force, but which ones is not stated in the available material.
